sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C05342 and card C05342-K1. On 2016-12-03 at 14:28:59, an online transaction (ID 3509850) for $300.00 was attempted using the device profile rv:59.0 | Mac OS X 10.12 | firefox 59.0 | 2560x1440. The bank's real-time risk score for this transaction was 0.37, but the transaction model scored it at 0.832 against a 2.1 percent base rate. The activity is highly suspicious because this rare, fully specified device profile appears on only 7 cards in the entire dataset and was used on 4 other connected cards (C07687-K1, C10287-K1, C11244-K1, C12552-K1) belonging to 6 other customers between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-30. Three of those prior uses were marked as a new device, and the transaction model scored four of those other-card uses as fraud. This pattern of a single rare device being used across multiple unrelated accounts strongly indicates a fraud ring conducting card-not-present fraud. The total exposure for this specific case is $300.00, though the broader device network involves $1,425.03 in flagged activity.
